thread:
Maya: quick sync  working on the econ dashboard card for shared prefetch savings. core question: if a cached KV benefits multiple routes, how should console apportion the token credits?
Trent: my pragmatic take: default to session-weighted allocation (tokens-per-session) and fall back to route-affinity when session data absent. easier for finance to digest.
Liam: session-weighted is intuitive but noisy for micro-sessions. propose a floor (min allocation) and an optional smoothing toggle so small-session noise doesn't dominate charts.
Sara: we also need to call out sampling bias: hot paths are sampled at 10%. recommend an upsampling factor in the aggregation step or flag low-sample estimates.
Maya: UX idea: three radio modes in the card: "session-weighted", "hotpath-count", "model-sku". each has a short help tooltip with the exact formula and a link to the math appendix.
Neil: add a provenance link on each row that opens a modal with the sampled trace examples and aggregate stats (sample rate, sample size, confidence interval). ops needs this for disputes.
Trent: what about rollouts and fallbacks? if a request hits A then falls back to B, who owns the credit?
Liam: assign to served model (B) for billing determinism, but store the chain and allow an optional split view for rollouts (e.g., attribute historically based split 70/30). display chain in provenance modal.
Sara: measurement plan: add `cache_origin` to traces with values: prefetch, kv_cache, shared_prefetch. nightly aggregation computes savings = max(0, baseline_tokens - tokens_served) per trace. baseline = median tokens for that prompt_shape + model_sku.
Maya: can you paste a quick pseudo-SQL for the nightly job so I can wire the provenance modal fields?
Liam: quick sketch: ```
WITH traces AS (SELECT trace_id, ts, tenant_id, route, model_sku, prompt_shape, tokens_served, cache_origin FROM events WHERE ts >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 day)), baseline AS (SELECT prompt_shape, model_sku, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tokens_served) as median_tokens FROM traces GROUP BY prompt_shape, model_sku) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.route, t.model_sku, COUNT(*) as sample_count, SUM(GREATEST(b.median_tokens - t.tokens_served, 0)) as token_savings FROM traces t JOIN baseline b ON t.prompt_shape = b.prompt_shape AND t.model_sku = b.model_sku WHERE t.cache_origin IN ('prefetch','shared_prefetch') GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.route, t.model_sku;
```
Trent: ops flags to decide: (1) credit in realtime vs billing-window, (2) per-tenant visibility-only opt-out. legal will want opt-out for some enterprise accounts.
Sara: realtime credits amplify variance. prefer billing-window aggregate with 7-day rolling smoothing and mark estimates when sample_count < 100.
Neil: how do we indicate estimated vs settled in the UI?
Maya: small badges: orange "estimated" with hover showing sample_count and sample_rate, green "settled" for window-closed numbers. also allow a "view raw traces" button in the modal.
Trent: who will own the nightly job? ops or platform infra?
Liam: platform infra can build the pipeline; eng-platform owns the aggregation SQL/spec. I'll own initial implementation and hand off to ops after stability.
Sara: quotas corner-case: if we credit savings but upstream prefetches increased infra load, we risk under-recovering cost. add a mismatched-cost alert when credited_savings_value > infra_cost_delta * 1.1.
Maya: agreed. add detection rule and an investigation workflow. ops-bot: creating issue template now.
ops-bot: created INFRA-2563 "Investigate credited prefetch savings vs infra cost delta" watchers: Maya, Sara, Liam, Trent.
Neil: rollout plan and timeline?
Maya: prototype by next Wed, A/B with 10% tenants the following week, full roll by month-end if metrics stable.
Trent: I'll open a Console PR for the card with the three-mode toggle and stubbed modal.
Liam: landing `cache_origin` trace tag today and will push the nightly aggregation draft.
Sara: updating sampling docs and variance heuristics. will add examples for finance review.
Maya: acceptance criteria: nightly job < 30m, per-route+per-model savings table, provenance modal with sampled traces, A/B for 10% tenants, docs + product sign-off. ping me with blockers. :sparkles:
